dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't see any empty seats.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, sorry for the inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: The Lord built such a big palace yet with no place for guests to wait at the gate. I found it confusing as well.

dialogues.speaker: Goshtasb
dialogues.text: Please wait. I will make sure to report to her about this.
